property: RFC 3022 formally obsoletes RFC 1631 and expands/clarifies the family by distinguishing Basic NAT from NAPT address-plus-port multiplexing.

sources.supports: original NAT model and implementation context
formal obsolescence and Basic NAT/NAPT distinction

negative_claims: NAPT should not be projected backward onto every RFC 1631 NAT implementation.
NAT is not equivalent to firewalling or private addressing.
open_questions: Recover vendor implementation chronology separating Basic NAT and NAPT.
